title: coherence: VerdictInputs.FailReasons is never read, and its writer drops ship fail reasons; one audit-report case is untested
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 28 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) VerdictInputs.FailReasons is never read inside the coherence package. Its only writer, core/failure_dossier.go:87, fills it from AuditFailReasons but not ShipFailReasons. (2) No unit test covers an audit report that exists but has no readable sentinel; ReadCycleVerdicts reports auditRan=true in that case. (3) go/acs/cycle1149/predicates_test.go:209 cites coherence.go:127 by line number, which is now stale.
fix: Either consume FailReasons, including ship reasons, where coherence decides, or delete the field and its writer. Add the sentinel-less audit test. Drop the line reference.
acceptance: No write-only field remains in VerdictInputs
An audit report without a readable sentinel has a pinned outcome (test)
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: A write-only field plus one missing test; no behavioural impact while nothing reads it.
